current_prompt.body:
CALCULATE the probability that, for a stick of unit length broken at two uniformly random independent points, the ratio of the shortest piece (L_min) to the longest piece (L_max) is at least 1/4.
RETURN the probability as an exact rational number or simplified expression.

current_plan.body:
GENERATE the joint distribution of two independent uniform break points on the interval [0,1]
ORDER the break points to define the segment endpoints
CALCULATE the lengths of the three resulting pieces as functions of the ordered points
DEFINE the condition that the ratio of the shortest piece to the longest piece is at least 1/4
IDENTIFY the region in the ordered-point space where the condition holds
INTEGRATE the joint density over that region to obtain the exact probability
SIMPLIFY the resulting expression to a rational number in lowest terms
RETURN the simplified probability
